preview.addon.description.comment: Summary field label on the card of an MCP bundle, a VS Code extension or a browser extension. The description the package gives of itself. The value beside the label is text from the file and is never translated. Technical names (MCP, VS Code, Node.js, manifest keys) stay as they are. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.addon.manifestVersion.comment: Summary field label on the card of an MCP bundle, a VS Code extension or a browser extension. The value beside the label is text from the file and is never translated. Technical names (MCP, VS Code, Node.js, manifest keys) stay as they are. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
